notes.title: Current Status
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have started testing Reborn F.O.G

With this update we are aiming to locate and fix every bugs as we can find in early stage.
Also we are adding more and more horror features to keep game in high tempo.
With final touches, we are going to release a gameplay trailer to show you what we have made.

For now Stay safe, Stay healthy...

Contact: support@plusumbrella.com

notes.title: Reborn F.O.G Devlog
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,

Welcome to Reborn : Fate Of Gods. With this devlog we can make a little sneak peek to the game.

Current Status:

- We are still developing the game and trying to find the best horror materials for best experience.
- Optimizing the game for low performance computers.
- Made a little changes in story with more explained and clear way.
- Planning to finish and release the game in Q4 of 2022.

If you have any questions and requests please feel free to contact us. <3

Contact mail: crackedumbrella@gmail.com
